meta.source: Calibrated from Vietnam National Grid data (2024). Baseline factor 681 gCO2eq/kWh (official Ministry of Agriculture & Environment / HUST 2024 figure). Peak premium (+10-12%) reflects coal/thermal dispatch during morning and evening load spikes. Solar discount (-15-20%) reflects midday rooftop solar injection.

baseline_home_evening.description: Unmanaged home charging. Fleet plugs in after commute return. 80% of daily demand concentrated in 6-10 PM.

optimized_workplace_daytime.description: Managed workplace charging at offices, universities, Metro stations. Weighted toward 10 AM-2 PM solar window.
